# Open questions — October 12, 2026, primary power follow-up

1. Will H2 capex reach MSFT cash PP&E $83.322bn, GOOGL PP&E purchases $99.402bn, AMZN gross purchases $116.589bn and META inclusive capex $86.58bn? Late-October Q3 results and updated guides will test these run rates.

2. How much of each capex dollar is accelerator systems versus prices, buildings and power? Customer mix and cash/lease reconciliations in late-October results and NVIDIA's November report would move mix.

3. What is Big Four's actual share of NVIDIA revenue after customer recasting and indirect AI-cloud purchases? Named-customer/cohort definitions in the expected November report would test the held 45% base.

4. Will NVIDIA Q3 FY27 Data Center reach $103bn, and will Q4 support own $128bn versus required $129.86bn? Expected 2026-11-18 results/guide will answer; company confirmation is still needed for the date and no Q3 segment consensus was supplied.

5. What is AMD's recognized 2026 Instinct revenue, excluding EPYC, and when do Meta/Azure Helios plans convert? A GPU-only disclosure and shipment timing in early-November AMD Q3 results would permit a variant from $14bn.

6. Will 2027 capex guides rise and AWS margins remain resilient after depreciation/power costs? Late-October commentary and January-February 2027 full-year guides will test persistence.

7. Are the channel respondents independent, which two clouds are involved, and is custom share measured in units, racks or dollars? Vendor methodology/order-cohort detail or matching customer disclosures before the late-October/November results would validate the incremental-share signal.

8. Which sites in the disclosed Microsoft FY2027–33, Alphabet 2026–31 and Meta 2027–28 lease windows have firm power-ready MW and rack delivery/acceptance dates? Lease windows are now documented; site schedules and any cancellation or staged deployment remain unresolved. Late-October results/2027 guidance and November supplier commentary would answer.

9. Do stable 20–30 week neocloud lead times apply to new orders or existing allocations, and how do they compare with a prior check? A comparable follow-up check before November's NVIDIA report would distinguish normal procurement cadence from new delay.

10. Do specific NVIDIA rack contracts gate transfer of control on installation, acceptance or energization? The disclosed control-transfer policy does not reveal customer-specific conditions. Public contract detail or November earnings commentary, together with a dated site slip and supplier value, would justify a revenue timing revision.

Partially answered: primary lease windows and general revenue policy are mapped. Still unresolved: site power-ready MW, customer-specific acceptance dates, supplier value and whether the anonymous planner refers to any of these sites.

Next independent session: none scheduled now; late-October/November disclosures are the next dated tests.
